title: Jellies
description: A dozen jellyfish, nine moon jellies and three sea nettles, drift through dark water under light from the surface. Every bell, arm and tentacle is see-through and drawn in any order with weighted blended OIT. Turn it off to compare with plain alpha blending. Each bell pulses on its own rhythm and its tentacles trail behind it. Drag to stir the water, or tap a jelly to make it flinch, dart off and flash.
line: Translucent jellyfish drawn in any order. Tap one and it flashes.
hint: drag to stir · tap a jelly to startle it
